lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five identifiable horizontal rows and several vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, intersecting with horizontal rows of blobs to form a distinct lattice-like pattern on the mid-to-posterior lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge is visible running horizontally across the upper flank, marked by a sharp gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and deep shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark, elongated shapes (ectoparasites or commensal fish) attached to or hovering near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin and the ventral-lateral flank.
